teamData.name: Ronald Citrano
teamData.description: Dr. Citrano earned his Doctor of Dental Surgery in 1984 from the University of Texas in Houston. He is a member of the American Dental Association, the Texas Dental Association, and the Dental Association of Southeast Texas. Dr. Citrano was born and raised in Beaumont, Texas and has been living in Bridge City since 1995. Immediately after graduation, he associated in Port Arthur from 1984-1987. In 1987, Dr. Citrano opened his private practice in Beaumont. His priorities in life are God, family, and taking care of his patients. His hobbies are spending time with his family, researching nutrition and healthy lifestyles, and working on projects around his home. He gives God the credit for giving him the passion and the skill to provide quality dental care for all of his patients. He has an eagerness for learning new dental and health knowledge and sharing that knowledge with both his staff and patients. His mission in practicing dentistry is to educate his patients by taking time to thoroughly explain what treatment is necessary to get and maintain a healthy mouth. His goal is to provide each patient with affordable, quality dental care that will help them keep their healthy smiles for a lifetime.

teamData.name: Elizabeth B.
teamData.description: Elizabeth B. began her career with Dr. Citrano in 2003, spending over 10 years being his assistant. Over those years, she learned all she could about the entire dentistry process. She is now the office manager but continues to go back to her roots from time to time being a backup assistant. Elizabeth’s favorite part of what we do is watching a new personality emerge as we work with a patient to restore their mouth because not only do we change their smile, but we also change their lives. She never gets tired of seeing that personality transformation.

teamData.name: Corina L.
teamData.description: Corina L. is Dr. Citrano’s lead assistant. She assists him with all your restorative procedures. Ranging from simple fillings to more advanced procedures like crown and bridges, extractions, and root canals. She Graduated from Kaplan College in 2013 with her RDA and has worked with Dr. Citrano ever since. Corina says the most rewarding part of her job is “making her patient comfortable while in her dental chair during treatment and building trust with each one. When she is not with her work family, she enjoys boating, surfing, skateboarding, and taking trips in her camper with her husband, son, daughter and 3 dogs.

teamData.name: Kayla P.
teamData.description: Kayla P. is Dr. Citrano’s 2nd assistant. She obtained her RDA license in 2018. She is an integral part of our team. Her duties are to assist Dr. Citrano with all dental procedures, sterilization, and room setup. She has a knack for making our patients feel relaxed and well taken care of. After work she enjoys time with her husband and daughter and on the weekends, she enjoys gardening, going to the park, and shopping.

teamData.name: Brittany H.
teamData.description: Brittany H. graduated from LIT in 2010. She first came to work for Dr. Citrano in 2011 and returned full time in 2019. She strives to deliver the absolute best personalized and preventive care at every appointment to ensure patients have a positive experience. In her free time, she enjoys spending time with their three boys. Brittany enjoys gardening, natural health, and interior decorating.

teamData.name: Tesha C.
teamData.description: Tesha C. graduated from LIT in 2006 and has been practicing as a Registered Dental Hygienist for 17 years. She has been employed by Dr. Citrano for 11 years. Tesha loves educating her patients because their smile is her everyday reward. She enjoys spending time with her husband Brandon and chasing her kids around the world to watch them perform in all their extracurricular activities.

teamData.name: Hailey J.
teamData.description: Hailey J. has worked with Dr. Citrano off and on since 2015. She can do anything from insurance to treatment coordinator. She took a few years off to pursue her associate degree in Surgical Technology. She worked at St. Elizabeth for a few years before she decided to stay home with her babies. She comes in and works with us as needed. She has worked with us for the last year, but the time has come for her to return to her five kiddos ranging from 13 – 2 yrs old. She enjoys family game nights, camping trips and watching their kids play their favorite sports. When she isn’t being a full-time mommy she enjoys pottery, painting, and antique shopping. Hailey says “Dr. Citrano and his wife have been such a blessing in my life over the years, he brought me in without any experience and showed me the ropes of dentistry and what it means to be a team player.”

teamData.name: Thyra F.
teamData.description: Thyra F. has been a Dental Assistant for 11 years. She started her career in California and moved to Texas 3 years ago. She has worked in pediatrics, general dentistry, and periodontics. She decided to take this career path because she has always had a passion for helping people look and feel their best. Thyra has a toddler who takes up most of her free time, but in her spare time she likes to read and go dirt bike riding with her husband and family. She also likes to re-purpose furniture. She has 3 dogs and one cat. “I am blessed to be a part of Advanced Family Dental Care with Dr. Citrano and team”.

faqData.question: What are your office hours?
faqData.answer: Our office is open Monday to Thursday, 7:30 AM - 3:30 PM. We're closed on Friday-Sunday.

faqData.question: Do you accept dental insurance?
faqData.answer: Yes, we file to most. Please contact us to verify your insurance.

faqData.question: What if I have dental inssurance?
faqData.answer: Our goal is to help patients get the care they need without any additional stress or delay. If your health insurance provides dental benefits, our financial office will work with you to optimize your coverage while minimizing your out-of-pocket expense. We are also happy to help you file insurance claims to expedite your reimbursement from non-participating plans.

faqData.question: How can I schedule an appointment?
faqData.answer: You can schedule an appointment by calling us at (409) 835-9846 or using our online form.

faqData.question: What services do you offer?
faqData.answer: We offer a range of services including cleanings, fillings, crowns, bridges, and more.

faqData.question: Do you treat children?
faqData.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive dental care for children of all ages.

faqData.question: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faqData.answer: Contact us immediately at (409) 835-9846. For severe cases, visit the nearest ER.

faqData.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqData.answer: Routine dental checkups and professional cleanings help ensure your smile remains in tip-top condition and that any developing problems receive the prompt care they require. While it’s a good idea to schedule a checkup and cleaning twice a year, longer or shorter intervals between routine visits depend on your specific needs.

faqData.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqData.answer: We accept cash, credit cards, personal checks, and PPO insurance.

faqData.question: Do you offer Dental Cleaning?
faqData.answer: Yes, we offer professional Dental Cleaning services for a brighter smile.

faqData.question: What should I bring on my first visit?
faqData.answer: To provide efficient service, we ask you to please bring your insurance card, an ID, plus any referral slips or diagnostic records given to you by another office. If you are taking medications, please note or make a list of what they are as you will need to provide that information. If you'd like to save some time, you can fill out some of our forms online.

faqData.question: Are you accepting new patients?
faqData.answer: Yes. We always welcome new patients and their families for care. Feel free to give us a call or reach out to us online to schedule a first visit or for any additional information on our office. We look forward to hearing from you!
